System for fitness clubs and sports schools

Memberships, entry by QR or face ID, class booking and trainer schedules in one system, with reminders to members whose pass is running out. Qilich builds the MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 108 mln; the full version in 14–22 weeks.
